packages.name: cockpit
packages.summary: A presentation layer that lets an agent publish rich output as a readable web page instead of a wall of chat text.
packages.problem: Long or structured agent output (reports, comparisons, diagnoses, decision lists) is hard to scan and impossible to find again when it lives in a chat.

packages.name: exploring-first
packages.summary: Separate gathering information from drawing conclusions by delegating the gathering to a subagent.
packages.problem: An agent trained to answer completely mixes research and conclusion in one response, which produces premature conclusions.
triggers: three or more tool calls expected

packages.name: it-leader
packages.summary: An independent, read-only reviewer that checks whether a problem analysis found ALL bottlenecks, using the lens of the IT operations leader from The Phoenix Project and The Unicorn Project.
packages.problem: The author of an analysis cannot see their own blind spots, and a reviewer who adopts the author's framing only confirms it.
triggers: look at it as the IT leader

packages.name: logging-agent-events
packages.summary: A hook writes every tool call of an AI agent, masked and shortened, to a local SQLite event log; the agent adds deliberate events such as decisions and blockers through the same script.
packages.problem: An agent forgets what it did once the context fills up or the session ends, and an instruction to log important steps is dropped exactly when the agent is busy.

packages.name: making-flows-visible
packages.summary: A flow board that shows, per flow, where time goes, what it leans on and which dependencies only one person or agent knows.
packages.problem: A drawing of a flow shows the steps but hides waiting time, dependencies and single points of knowledge, so nobody sees what breaks when one person is away.

packages.name: presenting-decisions
packages.summary: Put every decision to the owner in a fixed, self-contained table so they can decide with one word.
packages.problem: Agents present decisions as bare lines that force the owner to reconstruct context, which is slow and error-prone.
